caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a wooden furniture piece, likely a tall cabinet or secretary, colored in medium brown with detailed shading to represent wood grain. The cabinet stands on two ornately carved legs at the front, with a solid base connecting the legs. The lower half of the furniture has a distinct outward curve, while the upper portion is straight and rectangular, ending with a decorative cornice at the top. Attached to the side are three yellow-gold-colored ornate handles, one on the top section and one on the curved section, with another partially visible, likely indicating the presence of drawers or doors. The background is plain, off-white, and the drawing is framed by a thin rectangular line. At the bottom, the scale "SCALE - ONE AND ONE HALF INCHES TO THE FOOT" is written in red capital letters, with a signature and date in the bottom right corner.
title: Secretary (Cabinet Top Desk)
